classification.difficultyReason: Apply the monthly interest and balance calculations repeatedly, then interpret the interest and principal repaid.

content.prompt: Complete the table for a home loan of $\$350\,000$ at a rate of $7.6\%$ p.a. with a monthly repayment of $\$2471.26$. Round each month's interest to the nearest cent.

answer.worked:
Use $I=P\times\dfrac{0.076}{12}$ and ending balance $=P+I-R$, rounding each month's interest to cents. Each ending balance becomes the next starting balance.

Month 1:
$$\begin{aligned}I&=350000\times\frac{0.076}{12}\\&\approx\$2216.67\\\text{Ending balance}&=350000+2216.67-2471.26\\&=\$349745.41\end{aligned}$$
Month 2:
$$\begin{aligned}I&=349745.41\times\frac{0.076}{12}\\&\approx\$2215.05\\\text{Ending balance}&=349745.41+2215.05-2471.26\\&=\$349489.20\end{aligned}$$
Month 3:
$$\begin{aligned}I&=349489.20\times\frac{0.076}{12}\\&\approx\$2213.43\\\text{Ending balance}&=349489.20+2213.43-2471.26\\&=\$349231.37\end{aligned}$$
Month 4:
$$\begin{aligned}I&=349231.37\times\frac{0.076}{12}\\&\approx\$2211.80\\\text{Ending balance}&=349231.37+2211.80-2471.26\\&=\$348971.91\end{aligned}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: What is happening to the interest over time?

answer.worked: The interest decreases each month because it is calculated on a decreasing starting balance.

children.label: c
children.prompt:
What is the total repayment over the four months?
Compare this with how much of the principal you have paid off.

answer.short: $\$9885.04$ repaid, of which only $\$1028.09$ reduces the principal.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}\text{Total repayment}&=4\times2471.26\\&=\$9885.04\\\text{Principal repaid}&=350000-348971.91\\&=\$1028.09\\\text{Interest paid}&=9885.04-1028.09\\&=\$8856.95\end{aligned}$$
Only $\$1028.09$ of the $\$9885.04$ repaid reduces the principal; the remaining $\$8856.95$ pays interest.
